thread:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] Customers reporting intermittent 5xxs for hosted generation in apac and eu after cross-region cache sync. Public status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1901234567

oncall-mia: I'm leading. quick triage: cache-sync jobs, routing, and recent config pushes. @sre-otto pls join.

sre-otto: joining. seeing delta between cache replicas causing inconsistent KV reads; failing requests mostly on long-context workloads. error sample: 5xx "cache-miss-consistency"

eng-syl: I see a scheduled sync job bumped to parallel mode at 02:15Z to speed up catch-up. pausing parallel sync and reverting to serial now. Command: `cache-syncctl set-mode apac serial`

support-lucy: posting short customer note: "We're investigating intermittent 5xx errors for generation in APAC/EU. Mitigations are in progress. Details: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1901234567"

incidents-bot: MITIGATION: sync mode reverted, draining affected cache-pods, and routing long-context requests to eu-fallback. Observed 5xx drop from ~13% -> ~2% in 8m.

oncall-mia: applied temporary traffic-split: 90% local, 10% eu-fallback for known affected tenants. Also added extra cache-memory to two hot pods.

sre-otto: collecting consistency diffs and heap snapshots for RCA. setting metric alerts for cache-staleness > 50ms.

product-evan: notifying impacted customers and proposing 1 day of credits. drafting FAQ for CS.

support-lucy: updated tickets and posted status update.

incidents-bot: STATE: mitigated -> recovering. public page updated. Next update in 30m. Postmortem owners: @sre-otto (ops), @eng-syl (sync job), @product-evan (customer comms). Thread limited to leads.
